answer: Honest identities face a beacon draw: VRF picks 5% each epoch, and the drawn must file proof of work within 2 epochs. A forger's tundra of clones cannot know which will be drawn. Contrast the bills: honesty costs one proof per draw. Forgery locks 120,000 units for 1,000 clones; a missed draw freezes rewards 6 epochs, two misses slash 50% of stake. basalt math: forgery costs more than honesty.
